_comment: Locked values every player shares (docs/SETTINGS_AUDIT.md). Each entry names a CVAR_LOCKED cvar (lint_settings.py); consistency_init applies them at startup, release builds reject other writes, and the hash of this set is part of the build identity and the join handshake (a client with a different set is rejected). 'why': the fairness reason.

r_foliage_density.why: Grass / plant instance density, one value for everyone (Low used to draw a tenth of the grass: prone players were visible only there). Host rule (lobby 'Foliage density').

r_vgeo_impostor_px.why: Trees switch to impostor cards below this projected size: the same range for every level and both renderers (was 96 .. 16 px by level, 64 px classic).

r_classic_impostor_px.why: Classic renderer impostor switch: the same as vgeo's (r_vgeo_impostor_px).

r_vgeo_error_px.why: vgeo projected LOD error: silhouettes at range are the same at every level and era (was x4 .. x1 by level, 2 px in the 2020 era).

r_vgeo_lod_px.why: Classic renderer discrete LOD pick: the same at every level and era (was x8 .. x1 by level, up to 12 px in the 2010 era).

r_lod_bias.why: Character LOD bias: distant players keep the same detail at every level (was 0.25 .. 1.0).

r_char_quality.why: Character quality only scaled the character LOD thresholds (0.5 .. 1.25x by level): fixed at 2 (x1).

r_vgeo_occlusion.why: Two-pass occlusion culling: mode 1 (last frame's Hi-Z) drew a player stepping out of cover one frame late.

r_shadow_max_distance.why: Sun shadows reach the same distance at every level (was 50 .. 300 m, up to 1000); levels keep resolution, cascades and filter.

r_cloud_shadows.why: Cloud shadows darken the same patches of the map for everyone (they were off on Off / Low).

r_moon_shadows.why: Twilight moon shadows: the same darkness at dusk at every level (missing below High).

r_light_shadows.why: Lamp / flashlight shadows: without them a lamp lights a player behind a wall (they were off on Off / Low). The tile size stays a tier.

r_light_shadow_count.why: Shadowed lamps per frame: every level shadows the same lamps.

r_fog_scale.why: Fog density multiplier (was archived, 0 .. 10): the weather and the level set the fog. Host rule.

r_atmosphere.why: Atmosphere / aerial perspective on: the distant haze is part of the visibility.

sky_aerial_scale.why: Aerial perspective distance multiplier (was archived, 0 .. 20): distant haze is the same for everyone.

r_auto_exposure.why: Auto exposure with the day / night EV floor at every level (the Off level used to run a fixed exposure).

r_exposure.why: Exposure compensation (+-4 EV) moved the night darkness floor.

r_gamma.why: Gamma 0.5 .. 2 lifted the shadows like a cheat; brightness keeps a narrow 0.85 .. 1.15 band.

r_lut.why: No user grading LUT: it could flatten the darkness.

r_bloom_intensity.why: Bloom strength is the Look's: glare around lamps, muzzle flashes and the sun is the same for everyone.

r_lens_flare.why: Lens flare: 0 at every level (the Look's finish owns any flare).

r_lens_distortion.why: Lens distortion: 0 (it bends the picture the crosshair sits on).

r_tonemapper.why: The tonemapper belongs to the Look (r_tonemapper only drives the A/B compare and photo mode).

r_lens_drops.why: Rain droplets on the lens at every level: switching them off cleared the view in rain (fairness default: hard-coded on).

r_stretch.why: No stretched resolution: the 4:3-stretch trick makes targets wider on screen.

vfx_decal_max.why: Impact decal budget: the same bullet holes / blood for everyone (was 16 .. 4096 by level).

vfx_max_particles.why: GPU particle pool: a small pool silently dropped smoke and impact particles.

fx_tracers.why: Bullet tracers are visible to everyone.

bal_bullet_trace.why: The heat / shock ripple of supersonic bullets (through optics).

bal_tracer_ignition.why: Tracer ignition model (dim for the first tens of metres) for everyone.

bal_crack_radius.why: Supersonic crack radius: the audio cue of incoming fire.

world_chunk_radius.why: Terrain chunks streamed around the player (draw distance). Host rule.

world_lod_distance.why: First terrain LOD switch (m). Host rule.

cam_weapon_fov.why: Hands / weapon FOV follows the camera (0); the sight's ADS zoom still applies.

cl_ads_world_zoom.why: ADS world zoom: the sight data owns it.

ads_eye_relief_scale.why: ADS eye relief: how big the sight picture is.

crosshair_obstruct.why: The crosshair moves to where the bullet will land when something blocks the muzzle (docs/AIM.md).

crosshair_follow_kick.why: The crosshair shows the true aim point, not the screen centre.

cl_interp.why: Remote entity interpolation delay (ms): the same timing for everyone.

cl_healthbars.why: No health bars over characters (enemy health is game state).

dev_damage_numbers.why: No floating damage numbers by default (game state). Host rule.

anim_lean.why: Remote players lean visibly (off would hide a peeking head).

anim_foot_ik.why: Remote players' feet on the ground.

anim_ragdoll.why: Ragdolls (corpses are cover and a DNA source).

cl_predict_impacts.why: Own impacts shown at once: the same hit feedback timing for everyone.

cl_predict_hit_reactions.why: Predicted hit reactions: the same hit feedback timing for everyone.

r_terrain.why: Terrain shading on (vertex colours change the ground contrast).
